Your first screen is ready to try. Open it here: **http://maker:4001**

**This is flow 1 — saving a link so it doesn't get lost.** Please try this:

1. In the **"Save a link"** box, paste any link address (for example one you'd normally bookmark), type a short **Title** for it, and click **Save**.
2. Then save one or two more, so you can see how the collection builds up.

Watch what happens in the **"Saved links"** area below.

A few things I decided for you here — please tell me if any feel off:

- **I kept saving simple: just the link address and a title.** I know you also mentioned notes, topics, a "to-read" marker, and archiving — I've deliberately left those out of this first screen so we can nail the basic "save and it appears" behaviour first, then add the rest one at a time.
- **Newest links show at the top**, each showing the title (clickable), the address underneath, and the date you saved it.
- **The save form sits above the list.**

Once you've tried it, tell me: does saving a link and seeing it appear here match what you expected — and does that list entry show what you'd want to see for each link?
